answer: Admission needs an unaffiliated underwriter drawn by public beacon. Honest non-kin backers are sparse as a tundra: a farm cannot print willing ones, and each backer may bond only a few keys, so the marginal cost of admitting one more identity rises super-linearly per coalition. The underwriter stakes their own standing, sealed in a walnut of collateral that cracks and burns if the key is later proven sybil. That commitment is hard and clear as quartz, checkable at settlement without trusting a grader. Its limit: too few honest backers throttles real newcomers.
